candidate.user_submission: Di pikin never get convulsion before and e no dey convulse now. Di pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Di pikin na 59 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe with wahala. E never get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. I count di pikin breath for one full minute. E no get chest indrawing. Di pikin calm when I check am. E don dey cough for 3 days. We no get pulse oximeter. E no dey get wheeze wey dey come back. E dey breathe 40 times for one minute. E no get stridor when e calm. E no dey wheeze.
